title: Random Items
description: Adds random items such as popsicles and candies
body:
Random mod for random items for things and stuff.

Possible Uses:
- Create mod redstone link frequencies
- Obscure servers
- Pvp
- Other (Interesting) uses

![Alpha image with items showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/58e1bbb0d900b7f9e4c0d7db3e5d82f8c1cde605.png)

A really random mod that adds random things. Have fun!

Current Features:
- Popcicles (quick food/projectile),
- Popcicle block (normal block),
- Slingshot (shoots projectiles),
- Red 40 (edible dye),
- Popcicle stick (used with Red 40 and sugar to craft a popcicle)
